name: Cats Eye Emerald
summary: In the northern Barrens, the Cats Eye Emerald has drawn the eye of Ratchet's Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Venture Company bosses keep the fist-sized gem under guard at Boulder Lode Mine.

sections.title: A Fist-Sized Fortune
sections.body: Venture Company laborers struck a massive emerald at Boulder Lode Mine, northeast of the Sludge Fen. Word of the find spread quickly across the savanna. In goblin country, rare gemstones seldom stay secret. Trade gossip carried news from Ratchet's docks to Booty Bay, and Wharfmaster Dizzywig heard of the prize. He began plotting to send it to the open market in Undermine.

sections.title: Company Possession
sections.body: Venture Company management keeps the emerald inside the mine under heavy guard. Overseers, Enforcers, and chief operators such as Boss Copperplug defend it from rival cartels and fortune-hunters. Dizzywig has promised a fifty-percent cut to those who help him secure the gem.

faq.q: What is the Cats Eye Emerald?
aliases: what kind of gem is this
faq.answer: The Cats Eye Emerald is an unusually huge emerald, about the size of a fist, found by miners in the northern Barrens. Its clarity and size make it worth a fortune on the global market.
Venture Company miners unearthed the gem inside Boulder Lode Mine, northeast of the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Who wants the emerald in Ratchet?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig, who oversees shipping and cargo at Ratchet's docks, wants the stone for wealthy buyers through Undermine trading connections.

faq.q: Who holds onto the stone inside the mine?
aliases: who has the cats eye emerald
where to find cats eye emerald
faq.answer: Senior Venture Company supervisors hold the emerald inside Boulder Lode Mine. One of the Venture Co. overseers or enforcers carries it.

angles.text: As a miner, finding a pristine, fist-sized gem in an industrial dig like Boulder Lode Mine is the lucky strike every miner dreams of.
As a rogue, stealing an immense gem from under the noses of corrupt Venture Company taskmasters is a chance for opportunism.
